ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportZdjeciaTowarow' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportZdjeciaTowarow;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportZdjeciaTowarow] @RowVersion BIGINT, @PointOfSaleId INT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @RowVersion2 bigint = 0
select @RowVersion2 = maxrw from ( select max(DAB_CzasModyfikacji) as maxrw from ( select DAB_CzasModyfikacji from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid outer apply cdn.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) join CDN.DaneObiekty on DAO_ObiTyp = 16 AND DAO_ObiNumer = TwrGIDNumer join CDN.DaneBinarne on DAB_ID=DAO_DABId where DAB_Retail=1 AND psa_id = @PointOfSaleId AND DAB_TypId = 326 AND (@RowVersion = 0 OR DAB_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion) ) a ) b
select @RowVersion2 = ISNULL(@RowVersion2,@RowVersion) select @RowVersion2 as [@RowVersion], ( SELECT TwrGIDNumer as [@ProductId], DAB_ID as [@PictureId], case when dao_pozycja = (select min(dao_pozycja) from cdn.DaneObiekty join CDN.DaneBinarne on DAB_ID=DAO_DABId where DAO_ObiTyp = 16 AND DAO_ObiNumer = TwrGIDNumer AND DAB_Retail=1 AND DAB_TypId = 326) then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsDefault] from CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) join CDN.DaneObiekty on DAO_ObiTyp = 16 AND DAO_ObiNumer = TwrGIDNumer join CDN.DaneBinarne on DAB_ID=DAO_DABId where DAB_Retail=1 AND DAB_TypId = 326 AND (@RowVersion = 0 OR DAB_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion) for xml path('ProductPicture'), type) for xml path('ProductPictures') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportZdjeciaTowarow TO CDNRaport
